svg.text: 16,432 squares show where the world's 8.22 billion people live.
Population: World Bank (SP.POP.TOTL), latest year per country: 2025; UN WPP via Our World in Data for Anguilla, Cook Is., Falkland Is., French Guiana,
Guadeloupe, Martinique, Mayotte, Montserrat, Niue, Réunion, Saint Helena, St-Barthélemy, St. Pierre and Miquelon, Taiwan, Vatican, W. Sahara, Wallis and Futuna
Layout: Max Roser's 2018 cartogram (Our World in Data, CC BY), digitised by Matt Dzugan, with squares added or removed for the latest figures.
Not on the map (fewer than 250,000 people)
